summary: Frontend E2E of Compass Developmental Feedback System. All flows PASSED in ?preview=writing and ?preview=ot: welcome intro visible on entry; persistent Help Improve Compass button and header Exit control visible after starting; end-feedback modal opens, form fills, submit -> feedback-thanks -> done-close dismisses (POST /api/feedback -> 200); early-exit modal opens from exit-experience-button, reason+comments+Send&leave submits (200) and returns to entry (intro visible again); Leave anyway dismisses without a reason and returns to entry. OT flow reaches its stages via student-ot-intro-begin. Writing regression: draft textarea + 'Share with Compass' still produces coach response (no console errors). Persistent button positioned at bottom-right (20px gap) and does not overlay primary controls.
critical_code_review_comments: FeedbackModal.submit swallows submission errors and still shows feedback-thanks — safe from a UX/'never trap the student' standpoint (documented in code), but means genuine backend failures are invisible to the user; consider a subtle 'saved locally / retry' hint on failure.

EarlyExitModal.finish sets saving=false only after await; if the parent unmounts synchronously via onLeave() while saving is still true, React may warn about state update on unmounted component. Consider calling onLeave() before setSaving(false) or guarding with a mounted ref.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-open end-feedback at reflection stage was NOT verified (requires full LLM writing completion). Persistent-button path exercises the same modal and passed. All /api/feedback POSTs (event + end + early_exit) returned 200 against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
